newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cisco names executives in group reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Cisco names executives in group reshuffle.

text.p: Internet and networking equipment maker Cisco Systems Inc said in a statement on Monday it had appointed four senior executives as part of a reorganisation to manage the company's growth in Asia and around the world.
Tak Matsumoto, formerly the company's vice president for Japan Operations, had been named vice president for Asia Operations covering all of Asia including Japan.
Gary Daichendt, previously vice president of Cisco's Intercontinental Operations, had been named senior vice president of Worldwide Sales.
Don Listwin, formerly vice president and general manager of the company's Access Business Unit, had been named senior vice president for Cisco IOS Development and Marketing.

James Richardson, previously vice president for Europe, Middle East and Africa, had been named senior vice president of European Operations. His new position added responsibility for Australia and New Zealand, the statement said.
